name: robots/liorbenhorin__lerobot_so101_teleop
title: LeRobot SO-101 teleoperation in Isaac Lab: Rock-A-Stack Simple
intro: LeRobot SO-101 teleoperation in Isaac Lab: Rock-A-Stack Simple, adapted from liorbenhorin/lerobot_so101_teleop. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
